info.title: AeroPulse API
info.description: Real-time U.S. airport operations and weather intelligence built on FAA NAS Status and NOAA Aviation Weather Center data. All timestamps are UTC (ISO-8601). Reported FAA events, observed weather and derived indicators are kept distinct.
